requirement_text: The verdict is a pure function, reading no clock or environment
Preconditions gate the graded layers
Every breached rule is reported, not only the first
A run measuring nothing is never green
No metric divides without testing its denominator
Dependency and unsupported skips are excluded from the skip denominator
An expired quarantine entry fails the run
Layer semantics are read from registration, never hardcoded
Every flag that can change a result is recorded in metadata
Run-scoped fields are emitted per result, not only in a manifest
A verdict requires a gated run, and `gated` is derived rather than set
An ungated artifact is refused rather than scored
A diagnostic run returns no verdict code
Only a harness-computed selection yields a verdict
Debug artifacts are excluded structurally and by row marking
Every emitted and referenced taxonomy code is registered
Inventory counts match their rows
Traceability is verified in both directions, and derived columns match their source
An unknown case identifier is an error, not an empty run
A verdict is recomputable from stored artifacts
Each verdict rule produces the correct outcome at its threshold and on either side of it
Demotion follows match count, is reported, and security cases are never demoted
notes: An unreported demotion satisfies a ceiling by shrinking the number

requirement_text: The distribution check abstains below the minimum sample rather than publishing a verdict
Options are declared once and yield identical flags to both surfaces, with an invalid value rejected at parse time
An observation is assembled from tier results and case metadata
A truncated duration is excluded from latency statistics
Candidate content never enters the judge's instruction portion
The injection screen is programmatic and makes no model call
A screen hit aborts an ordinary case and grades a declared adversarial one
Assertions gate the case outcome conjunctively
Judging after an assertion failure is off unless requested, and never follows a fatal failure
A skipped judgement is recorded as not evaluated, never as zero
The judge receives no priority or requirement identifiers
The judge replies under an enforced schema, and a breach is treated as hijack
Judge output is normalized rather than rejected on a formatting breach
One judgement per candidate observation, with judge consistency measured separately
Aggregation declares a scale, and scores of differing scales are not combined
Calibration detects drift and records deviation within tolerance
The dual pass produces both a programmatic and a judged result
A judge timeout is attributed to the judge and never to the candidate, and an assertion failure dominates it
A judge engine not declaring structured output is rejected
One request per case, with no loop and no tool execution
Responses are normalized to a canonical shape carrying no vendor type
Tool arguments are parsed, never surfaced as a serialized string
Malformed tool arguments are a model finding, not a harness defect
The resolved model version is recorded, and its absence fails preflight
Provider errors are translated to a closed code set, preserving unmapped originals
Declared capabilities derive unsupported pairs without manual declaration
Replay reproduces every recorded observation, never one repeated
A stale or missing fixture is reported rather than silently replayed
Request spacing is honoured, and exhausted backoff skips rather than fails
A timeout is attributed to its source and records a truncated duration
A request is composed from the case, carrying its constraints and context
Engine selection routes to the declared adapter, and an unknown name is rejected
Mode selection is independent of engine selection
Malformed input is rejected at the boundary and never forwarded
A mandatory field must be present and non-empty, and missing is distinguished from empty
Unknown fields are rejected unless an override is declared
Values are explicitly cast at the boundary, never inferred
A rule set that judges nothing is rejected
A rubric carries at least one criterion
Anchors are required at levels 1, 3 and 5 and rejected outside 1 to 5
Required and forbidden tool sets do not intersect
The evaluation case remains a data type carrying no behaviour
A priority is unassignable without a registered matched condition, and cannot exceed its ceiling
Every rubric reference resolves
Every check references a constraint that was sent
Every constraint sent is referenced by at least one check
Tool expectations name only tools that were offered
Both loaders produce identical objects from equivalent input
CSV is read without type inference, and a blank cell is not a null
Duplicate column headers are detected before they are silently renamed
Ingested content is screened for injection unless declared adversarial
Valid input is accepted without alteration, including where every optional field is absent
One evaluation case is built per task and rubric pair, with an identifier stable across runs
An unregistered constraint kind warns rather than fails
An aggregation strategy declares its scale at registration
The version probe dispatches only on a real change, and its own failure dispatches nothing
notes: Probe is decision logic, not configuration

requirement_text: A debug run is ungated whatever its selection, and notifies without emitting a status check
notes: Record exclusion and notification are separate concerns

requirement_text: A diagnostic summary identifies the run, both refs, the changed areas and the resolved model version
notes: Model version is the premise a checkpoint comparison rests on

requirement_text: Code and fixture refs are independent, and their divergence reports staleness as a finding
notes: The only context in which a stale fixture is not a defect

requirement_text: Every graded result carries a registered evaluation family, and preconditions carry none
notes: Family is a registry value, not free text

requirement_text: Ingested content and identifiers are valid on every supported platform
notes: Each guards a defect silent on one platform

requirement_text: The request hash does not depend on line ending convention
notes: Second mechanism alongside .gitattributes

requirement_text: Every result records the platform it ran on
notes: A result that cannot say where it ran cannot be compared

requirement_text: Every value the harness did not author is isolated from judge instruction text
notes: Authorship, not custody, is the trust boundary

requirement_text: A case declaring adversarial content is graded by assertion and invokes no judge
notes: Asserts a negative; nothing else fails if the judge is invoked

requirement_text: Content the ingest screen matched is matched again by the Tier 3 screen
notes: The measurement the warn-not-abort decision preserves

requirement_text: The post-execution screen does not fire on ordinary authored prose
notes: A screen matching everything aborts every ordinary evaluation

requirement_text: Each registered assertion kind checks what it declares, and an unregistered kind or unit is a harness error rather than a model finding
notes: Our configuration error must never be recorded against the model

requirement_text: A response carrying no output is neither judged nor asserted against, and is recorded as a model finding
notes: An absence assertion passes against an absence, so a dead model reads as resistant

requirement_text: Authored-only fields are declared rather than inferred, and optional fields preserve absence
notes: Found by writing tests, not by reviewing the inventory

requirement_text: The format boundary is enforced at its edges, and a malformed source is named
notes: Added while writing loader tests

requirement_text: An unregistered aggregation strategy is rejected, and scales gate comparability
notes: A score with no declared scale cannot be compared with anything

requirement_text: The ingest screen does not fire on ordinary authored prose
notes: A warning that always fires is read by nobody

requirement_text: Required and forbidden tool sets stay disjoint after the join
notes: Specified as one of five checks and inventoried nowhere until now

requirement_text: A failure classification is declared as data, and registries report their contents
notes: Found by branch coverage; both are public surface nothing exercised

requirement_text: Every collected test is present in a design inventory, under the name the inventory gives it
notes: A design can specify a name nothing may carry, and a test can drift from its row

requirement_text: Dependencies are declared once, and any generated copy is checked against the declaration
notes: pytest-randomly was installed locally and declared nowhere, so CI held the weaker guarantee

requirement_text: Every callable carries parameter and return annotations, and annotation laziness comes from the interpreter rather than a stringizing import
notes: The rule predated the check by the whole project; 597 test callables violated it

requirement_text: Every Python file carries an SPDX authorship header naming the repository licence
notes: The split made the licence a per-file question: code installs across a licence boundary

requirement_text: Every package on disk is shipped by the build a consumer installs
notes: A hand-written list omitted execution.adapters; every consumer would have failed on import

requirement_text: Consumers are a registry the fan-out reads, and an unreachable one is a harness event rather than a failure
notes: The fan-out is the capability the split exists to provide

requirement_text: Selecting named tests is a manual selection and yields no verdict
notes: The debug workflow opened this: tests was neither declared nor a selector

requirement_text: A screen finding locates itself and names the vector it matched
notes: Shape had settled in implementation before the design stated it

requirement_text: A fixture path is built from identifiers that are valid on every supported platform
notes: Design conflict between sections 3.11 and 7.2, found by the first Windows run

requirement_text: A value that cannot be read is reported, and a detector's own failure changes nothing
notes: A corrupt baseline read as empty reports quiet nights forever

requirement_text: Every registered adapter is enrolled in the conformance battery, and one engine name maps to one adapter
notes: Parametrized over the registry, so a new adapter is covered without a list to update

requirement_text: Each adapter absorbs its provider response conventions so the canonical shape is identical across providers
notes: Each row names a real provider difference, not a restatement of the shared contract

requirement_text: Provider-side agentic execution is disabled explicitly, not left to a default
notes: A9 in practice: one SDK enables automatic function calling by default

requirement_text: A consumer is verified at the ref paired with the harness branch under test, and an unnamed branch falls back to a declared default
notes: A run is defined by a pair of refs; requiring an entry per feature branch would make the registry the thing that stops a branch being tested

requirement_text: An identifier is assigned once and never rebound, so no design inventory binds one identifier to two behaviours
notes: Every per-row check passed while an identifier was bound twice: the defect was a relationship between two rows, which a per-row check cannot see

requirement_text: The live traceability matrix is checked against the collected suite rather than against data derived from itself
notes: A check whose inputs come from its subject can only confirm the subject is self-consistent, which is not the property it was written to establish

requirement_text: A case count stated in the design index agrees with the inventory of the design it names
notes: Each design was internally consistent and the index describing all of them was not; 10146 is scoped to a document and this drift is between them

requirement_text: The Anthropic request states its effort level rather than inheriting an API default, so a provider-side default change cannot move a recorded observation
notes: Stated rather than inferred, as py-version is in .pylintrc; it enters the request hash, so moving it reports a stale fixture rather than drifting

requirement_text: The composed Anthropic request carries no field the model rejects: no disabled or budgeted thinking, no forced tool choice, no computer use tool and no sampling parameters
notes: Migrating needed no adapter change because none of these were present; nothing else keeps it that way, and a reintroduction would surface as a 400 during a live run

requirement_text: The judge engine is named in configuration with a declared default, so selecting another is a configuration entry rather than a code change
notes: A3 decided Gemini on 2026-09-19 and no file named it: the decision lived in prose while JudgeBinding defaulted to unbound

requirement_text: An engine may judge only when it is on the roster and declares structured_output, and both refusals are harness events
notes: The capability is the only qualifier; a permitted-engines list would need editing whenever an adapter is added

requirement_text: The constraint kind vocabulary registers count and ordering, and stays open so an unregistered kind warns rather than failing
notes: Seven authored constraints across the two triggered the promotion rule; form was refused in the same pass because format already covers it

requirement_text: No harness test reads a credential, so the precondition suite proves itself without spending any provider quota
notes: Documented in four places and protected structurally in CI, asserted by nothing: such a test passes locally with a key exported and fails in CI as an unrelated missing-environment error

requirement_text: The taxonomy carries a code for each direction of a finding, so a recall figure counts invention and omission separately
notes: A model reporting every defect plus several that do not exist would score identically to one reporting none, unless both are counted

requirement_text: The evaluation family registration procedure is enforced: the design table agrees with the code registry, every family a matrix names is registered, and every registered family declares a ground-truth mechanism
notes: Step 10 named one case against one assertion, and that case checked neither the table nor an emitted value

requirement_text: Every requirement the traceability matrix carries is stated in the harness test plan, so the plan never understates what is guaranteed
notes: Twelve requirements were traced and unstated; the plan states the requirements and the matrix traces them, and nothing compared the two

requirement_text: The judge carries its own model and is probed as its own subject, so a judge version change is detected rather than coincidental
notes: The probe walks the roster and the judge model was not in it; detection worked only while judge and candidate shared a model

requirement_text: A judgement is stored and replayed like a candidate observation, keyed by judge engine, stale when the request or the judge model moved, and never falling back to a live call when absent
notes: A replay run called the judge live, so it was neither free nor deterministic and the verdict was not recomputable from artifacts

requirement_text: Every tracked document and data file carries an SPDX header in its own comment syntax, so a file separated from its repository still states its licence
notes: REUSE requires every file to carry the tags, so 54 bare files meant the scanner claim in section 1.1 held for none of them

requirement_text: The judge mode is selectable and defaults to the candidate mode, and a live candidate with a replayed judge is refused at parsing
notes: A stored score describes a specific response, so replaying one against a newly generated response answers a different question

requirement_text: The operator runbook names only workflows that exist and inputs they declare, so a documented dispatch is one that works
notes: A dispatch naming an undeclared input is rejected by GitHub, and the reader concludes the procedure is broken rather than the page

requirement_text: A working branch is named for the day it was cut from main and for the work it carries, and the referent is registered
notes: A date without a referent is decoration, and a listing of six dates is six unknowns

requirement_text: A branch that has not been succeeded goes silent, then warned, then red, so the date is a ceiling rather than a label
notes: A branch that cannot take main and has not been succeeded is testing an integration that no longer exists

requirement_text: Everything reaches main through a stabilization branch, and main is merged into nothing
notes: A second route into main is a route around the integration test, taken by the branch most likely to need it

requirement_text: A broken observation blocks the run with no tolerated proportion, and the run exits 3 rather than reporting a model
notes: Broken was distinguished at the observation and collapsed into a model finding at the verdict, through V1 and V2

requirement_text: A skip is treated by its reason: unfinished work blocks, an outage is counted against a ceiling, a cascade is excluded
notes: An unwritten case had no reason of its own, so it took unsupported and became the most tolerated skip in the system

requirement_text: Tier 3 checks captured tool calls against the rule set's tool expectation and the offered set, as conjunctive gates
notes: Gate 5 collected eight cases against a capability no module implemented, and the corpus would have concealed it

requirement_text: An integration branch may name its cycle with a bare stamp, and every working branch must still name the work it holds
notes: A stabilization branch carries several tickets, so any single referent asserts something false about the rest

requirement_text: A declared adversarial case is graded by its assertions, which decide the verdict because no judge is invoked for one
notes: A19 removes the judge and passed required a rubric verdict, so a model resisting every attack was recorded as failing

requirement_text: A failing foundational case makes its dependents skip with QC_HARNESS_DEPENDENCY_UNMET rather than fail, and a dependency naming no collected case is reported
notes: framework-rules 3.4 specified the cascade, the marker was registered and used, and no hook read it

requirement_text: The vector registry detects confusable letters, so a homoglyph payload is visible in the record rather than passing as prose
notes: MQC_REQ_MDL_SEC_0005 expected a detection the registry could not make, so the fixture could not participate in the two-screen cross-check

requirement_text: Every file read and write declares an encoding, so the same commit cannot produce different values on Windows and Linux
notes: A missing encoding raises nothing and simply changes the value, on the two platforms CI runs on

requirement_text: A rule passes on the checks it declares, so a tool-only rule that complied is not failed for reporting nothing
notes: The tool evaluator reports nothing on success and passed failed a case with no results, so Gate 5 could not report a pass

requirement_text: A task declaring adversarial content pairs with no rubric, because a declared case reaches no judge and the rubric could never be scored
notes: The pair produces a case that can never pass and does not say why, which is the symptom corrected three times already

requirement_text: Every requirement identifier is declared exactly once, so a second row cannot silently replace what the first one meant
notes: T1 reads the declared requirements as a set, so a duplicate is invisible to it and surfaces as an untraced case elsewhere

requirement_text: A requirement register that has consumed 80 percent of its range is reported, so widening is decided with notice
notes: A ceiling that goes from silent to blocking is repaired by whatever is quickest, which here is a mixed-width register

requirement_text: No requirement register token is also a module code or layer token, and no identifier is both a requirement and a case
notes: MQC_CAS_ prefixed both registers, so a pattern written for one matched the other and a rename nearly clipped 458 case ids

requirement_text: Every registry's membership is asserted, so a member added or removed is a deliberate change rather than a silent one
notes: Six registries had public accessors nobody called and contents nobody asserted

requirement_text: A local .env is loaded without overwriting what is already set, and a line that is not an assignment is skipped with its number named
notes: The example file and the README both instructed readers to create a .env that nothing read

requirement_text: No credential file reaches a CI runner: the loader is inert there and no workflow reads one
notes: CI takes credentials from the GitHub Environment, and a file competing with that arrives by a path nobody audited

requirement_text: A missing or stale fixture is converted by dispatch into a skip carrying its taxonomy code, never propagated as an error
notes: The handler caught FileNotFoundError and ValueError, and the store raises neither, so the documented skip never happened

requirement_text: A provider connection is released once the response is captured, and retained only when the invocation asks for it
notes: A shared connection couples case outcomes: a wedged socket would be inherited by every case after it, where a per-case one reports as one skip

requirement_text: The judge dispatches through its own adapter and its own pacing, never the candidate's, even when both name the same provider
notes: Isolation that holds in the composed request and not in the transport is isolation on paper, and an unpaced judge shares the candidate's quota

requirement_text: A rule carrying no rubric is recorded as unjudged, distinctly from a run with no judge bound
notes: Section 4D permits a rubricless rule and the skip reasons were not extended, so a bound judge dereferenced None

requirement_text: A foundational case skipped before its call phase is recorded as not held, so a chain of dependents skips rather than errors
notes: A middle link skipped by the cascade reports when == setup, which the hook did not record, so the third link hard-errored

requirement_text: An adapter declaring structured output composes and parses a judgement, so the capability is an obligation rather than a label
notes: All three adapters declared structured_output and none could produce the mapping validate_judge_reply requires

requirement_text: A judge request composed by an adapter returns a mapping the reply validator can read
notes: JudgeBinding.invoke fed validate_judge_reply directly, and every double returned a mapping no adapter could produce

requirement_text: An engine on an already-served wire protocol is added by declaring its name, model, endpoint and credential variable, inheriting the protocol entire
notes: Registration was extensible and the adapters were not: every engine reimplemented protocol code that is not vendor-specific

requirement_text: Two engines on one protocol resolve their own endpoint and their own credential variable, never each other's
notes: An engine omitting its endpoint reaches the default vendor holding another vendor's key

requirement_text: Candidate and judge roles are derived from the registry and declared capabilities, never from a maintained list
notes: A list is a second place to forget, and an engine would arrive in one role because somebody remembered one list

requirement_text: A judge channel in replay mode loads a stored judgement and never reaches a provider
notes: FixtureKey keys the candidate only, so a bound judge was a live call whatever --mode said

requirement_text: A live judgement is recorded against the composed request it scored, so a later replay is bound to the same text
notes: A judgement is a score of a specific response, and replaying one against different output answers nobody's question

requirement_text: Collection orders every foundational case before its dependents, and an unknown foundation is reported at collection rather than at setup
notes: pytest-randomly is pinned to shuffle order and the cascade had nothing enforcing the one order it needs; five seeds of six errored

requirement_text: The consumer finds a credential file in its own root or, failing that, beside the engine roster in the harness checkout
notes: The file was created in the harness and the graded cases load from their own root, so it existed and was read by nobody

requirement_text: The consumer's configure hook searches both roots, so the loader being correct is not mistaken for the credential being found
notes: The loader worked and the file existed; the hook passed one root, which a loader-only case passes throughout

requirement_text: A provider reporting itself temporarily unavailable maps to its own code across every adapter, never to the unanticipated-failure code
notes: The first live run met 503 high demand on three of nine cases; the status map covered no 5xx and the artifact said the response could not be parsed

requirement_text: A transient provider failure is retried with backoff, alongside rate limits and timeouts
notes: The provider said the condition was temporary and the harness had backoff ready, and the two never met

requirement_text: A request the provider rejects as malformed carries its own code, distinct from the code for a failure nobody anticipated
notes: 400 fell through to the catch-all, which means nobody anticipated this and must stay findable

requirement_text: A gateway failure carries its own code, distinct from the provider reporting itself busy, because the operator response differs
notes: 502 and 504 come from an intermediary whose body is not the provider's; told to wait, an operator waits for a condition that never clears

requirement_text: A redirect the client did not follow, or a connection failure, is recorded as the engine being unreachable rather than as a model or judge finding
notes: No 3xx was mapped, and a proxy answering 302 with a login page is the ordinary cause

requirement_text: What an HTTP status means is stated once and reached by every interface through one function
notes: The first implementation put a status table in each adapter, which is three places for one fact

requirement_text: A provider failure while judging is mapped through the same taxonomy and contained as a skip, never escaping as a raw SDK exception
notes: A busy provider the candidate path handles as a retryable skip crashed a judged case outright

requirement_text: Containing a judge failure does not cost the tier boundary: the judge channel imports nothing from the evaluation tier
notes: Naming the hijack exception there was the obvious way to let it through and would have made execution import evaluation

requirement_text: A graded case whose repeat observations disagree on outcome is recorded as failed with QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT, never resolved by majority
notes: Two passes and a fail is a measurement that the model does not reliably do this; a majority would discard the finding

requirement_text: A run whose inconsistency rate reaches the ceiling exits 3 as unsound rather than 1, because single-sample results from an inconsistent model characterise nothing
notes: A4.1: consistency is a precondition for the other measurements meaning anything, not one measurement among them

requirement_text: A live run asked to fill gaps replays an observation already recorded and dispatches only what is absent or stale
notes: Under a rate limit, quota spent re-recording what exists is quota not spent on what does not, which stops a corpus converging

requirement_text: Each retry attempt dispatches on a connection it opened itself, so a failed attempt's connection state is not inherited by the next
notes: A half-open socket or a pool entry pinned to the instance that just failed is state every subsequent attempt inherits

requirement_text: The credential names the orphan check compares against are declared by each registered engine, never maintained as a list
notes: A maintained list is a second place to forget, which automatic enrolment exists to remove

requirement_text: Task substitution and tool coercion are screened as vectors in their own right, not only when a payload also carries override language
notes: The cases covering both families passed the cross-check incidentally, on phrasing they did not need

requirement_text: A role assertion is screened in the first person as well as the second, a split payload whether spelled or numbered, and an extraction request without its trigger verbs
notes: The patterns assumed the attacker tells the model what it is, used digits, and required an exact word boundary

requirement_text: A widened vector pattern still passes ordinary authored prose, verified against the phrasing an ordinary corpus contains
notes: A pattern widened carelessly breaks the no-false-positive requirement before it catches anything

requirement_text: A credential-shaped variable that no registered engine reads is reported by name, so a misspelled credential is not silently inert
notes: OPEN_AI_APi_KEY differed from OPENAI_API_KEY by an underscore and a letter's case, loaded cleanly, and reached no engine

requirement_text: The range of judged scores per case is recorded across its observations and gates nothing, so a score moving inside the passing band is visible without failing a run
notes: Three observations scoring 4, 4 and 5 all clear a threshold of 4, so the verdict is blind to a spread that is real

requirement_text: A rate limit naming a quota period no backoff can outwait ends the attempts for that case instead of spending them, and the run records that the period was exhausted rather than only counting the encounter
notes: Measured 2026-09-26: the free tier allows 20 requests per day per model, which stalled a recording run at 19 fixtures

requirement_text: Whether a rate limit names an exhausted period is answered by the adapter from the provider's own body and never from the provider's retry hint, and an adapter that cannot tell keeps the retry
notes: Gemini quotes retryDelay 52s beside a quota that resets daily, so the hint would retry until the day turned

requirement_text: A run whose observations for one engine name more than one resolved model is unsound and exits 3, while two engines each naming their own model remain sound and an observation with no model is not counted as a second version
notes: The free-tier quota is keyed per model, so switching model to win a fresh daily allowance would silently mix two versions into one corpus

requirement_text: Every environment variable a registered adapter reads has a settable line in .env.example, so adding an engine cannot leave its credential documented nowhere a reader would look
category: .env.example, and design section 3.5 on adapter-declared values
notes: XAI_API_KEY arrived with the grok adapter and GOOGLE_API_KEY with the Gen AI client's second name; neither was documented until this check was written

requirement_text: The case and requirement counts stated in README.md are recomputed from the design inventories and the traceability matrix, so the repository's front page cannot describe a project it no longer is
notes: Both figures had drifted: 498 cases against 462 inventoried and 144 requirements against 184 traced

requirement_text: The whole chain, from the ingestion join through replay dispatch and the dual evaluation pass to a computed verdict, reaches both a green and a red verdict, and carries all three observations of a case through to the verdict
notes: Every stage was covered alone and their composition nowhere; the CI gates that would have reached the chain's end collected nothing and read an artifact nothing writes

requirement_text: The installed versions of the tools that gate CI satisfy the pins declared in pyproject.toml, so a local gate result predicts the CI one
notes: pylint 4.0.6 was installed against a >=3.3,<4.0 pin; Gate 1 exited 0 locally and 8 in CI on the same commit

requirement_text: The document and data scan reads only files the repository authors, so a generated file in a tool cache or build directory is never reported as missing a licence header
notes: pytest writes .pytest_cache/README.md; an earlier header pass had written a header into the local copy, so 11140 passed locally and failed in CI

requirement_text: What a run cost is computed from a dated price table and the tokens a provider reported, priced against an injected date, with an unpriced model yielding no figure rather than zero
notes: Every rate for gemini-3.8-flash doubles on 2027-01-01, so a stale table would report the smaller figure rather than an error

requirement_text: Cost is reported per case with the judge consumption kept apart from the candidate, and a replayed observation contributes nothing because it was paid for when it was recorded
notes: A run total says whether a weekly run is affordable; per case says which family is expensive, which is the decision a corpus owner makes

requirement_text: Every adapter reports the input, output, thinking and cached input counts its provider returned, through one method serving both the candidate and the judge path
notes: Three of the four counts were read from the usage object and discarded, and the judge path recorded none of them

requirement_text: A run stops rather than dispatching further once it has spent its configured ceiling, and stops immediately where a model it met is unpriced, because a cap that cannot be enforced must not appear enforced
notes: The unpriced hole was found by a case that passed for the wrong reason: claude-opus-5-5 is unpriced and its thinking cannot be disabled

requirement_text: HTTP 402 is reported as an exhausted balance rather than an authentication failure or a parser error, and is not retried, because the credential is valid and the remedy is funds
notes: Reachable from 2026-09-28 when the project first held prepaid credit; before that the status fell through to the catch-all parser code

requirement_text: A flag named on the command line counts as supplied even where its value equals the default, so the defaulted-engine warning marks only runs that chose no provider
notes: The earlier case named openai, a non-default value, so it could not reach the condition; gemini is the default and the only funded engine

requirement_text: A declared adversarial case whose provider refused to answer passes and records the reason and stage, while an empty response carrying no stated reason still does not pass
notes: Applies to the whole SEC family. Section 4.2.1 is preserved: the discriminator is evidence of a refusal, not absence of output

requirement_text: A provider's refusal is recorded with its own reason and the stage it occurred at, so a security outcome can be reclassified from the stored corpus rather than by running it again
notes: A real block returns zero candidates and a prompt_feedback reason; the double modelled a candidate with absent content, so nothing caught it

requirement_text: A judgement request carries a schema the provider accepts, with keywords it rejects removed on the way to the wire and the composed schema left strict for validating the reply
notes: Every judgement returned 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT on additional_properties, so no EVAL case had ever been judged live

requirement_text: A judgement is recorded and replayed per observation, keyed by the observation index the request carries, so repeat observations of one case do not overwrite each other
notes: JudgeRequest had no observation_index and the channel read it with a getattr default, so every observation keyed at zero and replay failed as QC_HARNESS_FIXTURE_STALE

requirement_text: The harness ships its own configuration inside the distribution and exposes where it landed, so a consumer reads the roster from the installed package rather than from an adjacent checkout
notes: A consumer read ../AP-Harness-QC/config/engines.yaml, absent in CI, so the roster loaded empty and the gate reported a judge engine missing from a roster never read

requirement_text: An injection vector matches text directed at the grader and not text that reports a score, so a response answering a scoring task is evaluated rather than aborted
notes: score_manipulation matched '**Mandatory Match Score:** 7.8 out of 10', aborting evaluation so the observation went unjudged and the case reported QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT against the model

requirement_text: A live judged run with --fill-gaps replays a judgement that loads cleanly and asks the judge only where none is recorded or the stored one is stale
notes: DispatchPlan carried fill_gaps and JudgementPlan did not, so obtaining two missing judgements meant re-judging all ninety-two, twice

requirement_text: Every registered execution flag is named by at least one case, or is a declared coverage gap carrying a reason and an expiry that fails the run once it lapses
notes: --max-spend accepted a ceiling that stopped nothing and --priority named a band and ran every band; configure_invocation reads the whole registry generically, so neither was unread and no read-based check could tell

requirement_text: A run selects the priority bands named by --priority and no others, refuses a malformed band rather than selecting everything, and carries the foundations a band rests on only when --with-prerequisites asks for them
notes: --priority was in the registry and the CLI table and read by nothing, so a job naming a band ran every band; the cascade crosses bands, so a band run alone needs its foundations and a band inside the sequence must not re-run them

requirement_text: Base outcomes established by one band execution are carried to the next without re-running the cases, so a dependent resolves against a foundation it did not collect and still skips when that foundation did not hold
notes: _BASE_OUTCOMES is in-process and cleared per session, so the p2 execution began with no memory that p1 ran; carrying the test rather than the outcome re-ran work reported minutes earlier and coloured the later band with an earlier band's failure

requirement_text: A carried outcome record is admitted only when the rules, harness commit, corpus commit, engine, mode and platform match the current run, and a mismatch refuses naming the field that moved
notes: Cross-run state fails silently: a stale record would pass a dependent on a foundation established against different rules. Both fallbacks are worse than refusing, since re-running is the waste this avoids and assuming it held is an assertion nobody measured

requirement_text: The consumer regression replays the consumer's graded layers and fails only on harness-attributable outcomes, so a finding about the model under test does not turn a harness regression red
notes: The regression ran only the consumer's deterministic gates, so two of the three harness defects that reached the case repository on 2026-09-28 broke the graded path unseen and surfaced when the consumer's own gate went red after a later push
